# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.gaps import uncovered_labels

OPEN = Span(480, 1080)


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        worked = [Span(480, 720), Span(780, 1080)]
        self.assertEqual(uncovered_labels(worked, OPEN), ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_edges_and_nothing_worked(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            uncovered_labels([Span(600, 900)], OPEN),
            ["gap 08:00-10:00 (120 min)", "gap 15:00-18:00 (180 min)"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(uncovered_labels([], OPEN)), 1)

    def test_full_cover_has_no_gaps(self):
        worked = [Span(480, 800), Span(700, 1080)]
        self.assertEqual(uncovered_labels(worked, OPEN), [])

    def test_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            uncovered_labels([Span(420, 600)], OPEN)
